allies.rationale_text: Lateral-thinking strengthens brainstorming by turning raw idea volume into genuinely reframed alternatives rather than more of the same answer.
allies.source_quote: Works when idea volume is genuinely valuable because the search space is still underexplored.
allies.affinity_rationale: Essential reframing mechanism — turns raw idea volume into 'genuinely reframed alternatives rather than more of the same answer' — differentiates productive brainstorming from mere repetition by providing the divergent quality that volume alone cannot.
allies.activation_condition: When brainstorming sessions need to produce genuinely novel alternatives rather than variations on the same underlying idea or the group's existing direction

antagonists.rationale_text: Authority-bias undermines brainstorming by causing team members to suppress their own ideas and defer to the senior person's framing, collapsing the divergent space the session needs.
antagonists.source_quote: Team members suppress their ideas due to pressure, loyalty, or the presence of a senior person (checking hierarchy at the door).
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Directly suppresses the core function — 'Team members suppress their ideas due to pressure, loyalty, or the presence of a senior person' — kills divergent generation by collapsing the group's search space to the authority's frame.
antagonists.activation_condition: When the presence or status of a senior participant is causing team members to self-censor their ideas or defer to the authority's framing rather than generating independently

structured_tensions.tension_text: Brainstorming conflicts with confirmation-bias when evaluation during generation selectively develops only ideas that confirm the group's existing direction.
structured_tensions.source_quote: brainstorming vs confirmation-bias: brainstorming conflicts with confirmation-bias (confirmation bias) when evaluation of ideas during generation leads participants to selectively develop only the ideas that confirm the group's existing direction rather than genuinely exploring the full possibility space.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Brainstorming conflicts with anchoring when the first idea introduced becomes the reference point that constrains the rest of the session.
structured_tensions.source_quote: brainstorming vs anchoring: brainstorming conflicts with anchoring (anchoring) when the first idea introduced in the session sets an implicit reference point that constrains subsequent idea generation, limiting the diversity of the possibility space.
